title: Link previews can find the banner
summary:
A small garden-tending day: better link previews, updated footer terms, and a community music app in the project list.

The website’s default SEO image now uses an absolute URL, so link previews can resolve the banner instead of guessing where a relative path points.

A compliance section was added to the Terms & Conditions text in the website footer.

The creative apps list and README now include Musify, a community music app that uses the Pollinations API for an AI assistant, voice commands, and playlist creation.
